name: Big Mal of Headingley

intro.text: Forty years in the pack. Two knees, one nose, and a medal for every bone I've broken.
They call me a legend in this pavilion. Let's see if you can tackle one.

win: That's a try for you, and a pint for me. Fair result.
after: Rugby league's thirteen a side, union's fifteen. We left the extra two at the bar.
